item.text:
No additional defect was confirmed in this pass. I added a consolidated replay script that captures the full audit workflow in [run_all_checks.sh](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/repro/run_all_checks.sh); it passes shell syntax validation and retains a separate log for every baseline, negative control, and expected-failure reproduction.

The audit remains at 28 confirmed findings. Highest-impact risks remain:

- LFU resynchronization causing replica value divergence,
- delta-snapshot corruption,
- decided-index regression during `AcceptSync`,
- persistent failed-write leakage and destructive suffix replacement,
- timeout retry duplication,
- LRU bincode deserialization failure.

Complete findings and evidence are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
